newsitem.title: UK: Germany issuing 2.8 mln bls crude tender on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Germany issuing 2.8 mln bls crude tender on Monday.

text.p: German oil supply agency EBV said it would request on Monday bids for the first tranche of crude stocks put up for sale by Germany to raise cash to lower the government budget deficit.
An EBV spokesman said bids were being requested for 450,000 cubic meters, or about 2.8 million barrels, of high sulphur (sour) crude held in nine tanks.
Bids would be considered for all or part of the volume and the tender would remain open for a week until Tuesday August 12, he said.
The winning company would be informed on the same day.
Bonn plans to sell more than 50 million barrels of crude in total or about 20 percent of national strategic reserves.
The crude is being pumped from salt caverns via the NWO pipeline to storage tanks at the German port of Wilhelmshaven.
Germany's economics ministry has said that the oil typically would be a mixture of 50 percent Iranian Heavy, 25 percent Arabian Light and 25 percent Iraqi Kirkuk.
Precise quality details for the first tranche would be issued later on Monday, EBV said.
